BackgroundGeolocation.note: a driver's phone must keep reporting position with the screen off — a foreground service with a persistent notification, declared in Play Console as a location foreground service. This is the one capability the rider app does NOT need.

comment: SEPARATE store app from both MELEK Move and MELEK Ride: drivers get PAID, which brings its own Play/App Store declarations (financial features, payout), plus background location. Same website, same sign-in.
